meta.source: Structure adapted from the Binance DESIGN.md (getdesign.md): single accent, separate numeric face, flat colour blocks, direction colours. Accent, canvas and fonts replaced.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Warm off-white, never pure white, so white cards read as lifted without shadows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and unselected chips sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary fills: photo placeholders while an image loads, grouped rows, quiet containers.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and between list rows. Decorative only — never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: inputs, unselected chips, secondary buttons. 3.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and every price. Also the deep block on the cover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas, surface or surface-soft: captions, units, helper lines. At least 4.9:1 on all three.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent. The single primary action per screen, the keep swipe, selected states and focus. Never body text, never a large fill. 10.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of anything filled with primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of selected chips and the disabled primary button. Primary text on it is 8.7:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: fits
tokens.usage: Money status: the meal fits the budget. Text and icons only, on surface or fits-soft.

tokens.name: fits-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the fits budget badge. Never a card or screen fill.

tokens.name: complete
tokens.usage: Money status: fits, but needs a little more to be a complete meal. Text and icons only.

tokens.name: complete-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the to-complete budget badge.

tokens.name: over
tokens.usage: Money status: over budget. Text and icons only. Never an error colour for anything else.

tokens.name: over-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the over-budget badge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the question the screen asks.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Meal names on cards and the meal screen.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Section heads inside a screen or card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pat the fish dry and season both sides.
styles.usage: Method steps and all running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Prices are typical lows, not quotes.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group labels, meta labels, badge words.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: The headline money figure on the meal screen.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every price, calorie and protein figure in running UI.

styles.name: num-sm
styles.usage: Small figures in meta rows and badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a badge or chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and between meta items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a row; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutters and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the primary action; top of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and photos.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Budget badges and the round swipe buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the top card of the deck, because it can be dragged. Everything else in the system is flat.
